fixes.what: Remove `loading="lazy"` from `` across all four pages
fixes.why: `logo-gold.svg` is already fetched in the header (and preloaded on index), so lazy-loading the identical cached asset in the footer is redundant and can cause a brief unstyled pop-in on fast scroll-to-bottom.

fixes.what: In `form.addEventListener('submit')`, move `var firstInvalid = form.querySelector(':invalid'); if (firstInvalid) { firstInvalid.focus(); }` after `form.reportValidity()`
fixes.why: While `reportValidity()` focuses the first invalid input in most desktop browsers, explicitly focusing it ensures deterministic keyboard and screen-reader behavior on iOS Safari when custom `.field__error` nodes are injected.
At 12px font size over `--deep` (#121714), 0.6 opacity yields ~4.3:1 contrast (just below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for small text); 0.72 lifts it safely above 5.5:1 while keeping the quiet hierarchy.
